statement: Mula's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Ketu; its presiding deity is Nirriti (goddess of destruction), symbolized by a bundle of tied roots. It is traditionally associated with getting to the root of things, even destructively — investigation and transformation that starts by tearing down.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
